source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: No hole map found; the order comes from the photos and the card's lengths. The front nine is taken as the east and middle holes and the back nine as the west loop. Holes 7 and 16 could be the other way round, and then 8/17 and 9/18 swap too.
unsure.2: Back tee not clearly visible; placed at the north end of the fairway by the pond. Traced 471 yd against 503 on the card.
unsure.3: Tee not clearly visible; placed in the fairway just west of the 2nd green.
unsure.6: Holes 6 and 11 are two side-by-side par 5s heading west; which is which is a guess from their lengths. Tees placed near the cart path. Bend points follow the mown strip north of the pine-straw island, then west along the southern fairway; traced length (547 yd) is just over the card's longest (538), the tee placement by the cart path being a guess.
unsure.16: Tee placed between the 6th and 11th greens; the hole bends right past a pad that looks like a forward tee.
unsure.17: Par 3 into a big green that may be a double green; tee placed on the pads east of it.
unsure.18: Tee not clearly visible; placed in the fairway east of the 7th green, the hole bending left up to the clubhouse.
unsure.11: Back tee not clearly visible; traced 452 yd against 570 on the card, so the real back tee is probably further east.
unsure.15: Tee placed on the pads beside the 14th green; the hole runs down the eastern strip.
unsure.8: Tee not clearly visible; placed just east of the 16th green, across the pond from the 17th green.
